mechanics_notes: 100-Ki Strike Super with a stance-based, multi-stage input sequence. After the startup pose, Rock, Scissors, and Paper are selected by their corresponding attack inputs and can be combined for up to three attacks. Rock is a short punch, Scissors blinds the opponent, and Paper is a palm strike that knocks the target away; current documentation describes the three-hit combination as a 3-hit sequence. The move stops the user in place during the selection sequence, so it is not a conventional combo starter.
evidence_boundary: Current Xenoverse 2-specific mechanics and acquisition evidence only; unresolved numerical/frame details remain bounded.
